finalDailyMethod.method: Reuse the same isolated libraries after the first daily run, starting at 50,050 and 100,050 items. Same daily-1 capture. In a copy of the built app only the green channel of the 50 generated PNGs changes from 100 to 101 to avoid a deduplication hit. Same plugin catalog. No changes to the production code paths.

scanMeasurement.method: Core comparisons on the same settled post-Electron fixture. After one initial scan, each round times an unchanged scan, a notification for one known file and a full-space refresh. Core processes run sequentially. A separate core process then publishes and reviews one real PNG revision per version; refreshMs excludes staging and final manual acceptance.
